svg.text: Exploiting metric space properties to eliminate impossible candidate clusters without computing distances

g.text: d_min = d(cA, cX) - d(f, cA) = 3.20 > r_lim
d(f, cX) >= | d(cA, cX) - d(f, cA) | > r_lim
1D projection along baseline cA → cX eliminates impossible candidate cX without metric evaluations.
Triangulating between 2 measured pivots computes orthogonal height h_f, strictly tightening the bound.
3D orthogonal projection yields the tightest mathematical metric bound on curved manifolds.
Tightened on demand with -sparse_dcc_extra_evals <N> without dense O(K^2) memory.
